en: I see. So you want to find places that serve local specialties.
Exactly. But to find the best places, you have to ask the locals. That's where you come in.
Hmm... I'm no expert, but if I find a good place, I'll let you know.
Great! I can hardly wait!
Ah, there you are. Find any great places?
Sorry, nothing new to report.
Oh, really? Well, please stop by again. I'll be here!
(No eateries to recommend right now. Maybe I'll go try somewhere new and come back later.)
(Hmm, which one should I recommend?)
(Maybe next time.)
(Maybe I should recommend Hakataso.)
Follow me.
Right behind you!
(Maybe I should recommend Hango Zosui Yama.)
(Maybe I should recommend Udon West.)
Brrr... Hokkaido sure is cold.
I hope I find a good place soon. Hopefully a really warm one, too.
(What's with him? Wait, haven't I seen that guy before?)
Brrr... Ugh...
Hey, you there. I can't shake the feelin' I've seen you before. What's your name?
Ever hear of that celebrity chef Tatsuya? Well, that's me. Maybe you've seen me on TV or something.
Oh, right. That's where I've seen you. You're some kinda cooking master, ain't you?
Well, I'm not just a cook, exactly.
These days, I'm doing this spot on a TV show where I help out local eateries across Japan by coming up with new dishes!
I don't get it. If you got ideas for new dishes, why don't you use 'em at your own restaurant?
But that's the whole idea for the program, helping others with my new dishes.
With that in mind, I have to ask. Could you recommend any eateries here in Tsukimino?
I ain't from around here, so I really can't say.
Oh, you're a tourist? Ah, no matter. I still have to ask.
Would you let me know if you find a great place that serves local cuisine here in Tsukimino?
I'll go try it out, and hopefully it will help me come up with an idea for a new dish.
You want me to find tasty eats for you? Ain't that your job?
Sure, but there's a limit to how much one person can do. I'll take all the help I can get.
You got a point there.
Think of it as a good deed! But I understand if you're too busy.
Fine. I'll give you a hand if I get around to it.
Thank you! And don't worry. I'll make it worth your while!
I'll use my vast experience with both cooking food and eating it to teach you how to make the most of your meals.
Fine, fine. I'll let ya know if I find anything.
Great, thanks! I'm looking forward to your recommendations!
So, cooking is a combination of ingredients? I'll try remembering that when I eat.
There are emotions and stories behind every dish, huh? I ain't no cook, but I think I get it.
That was a lot to remember. But I think what you're sayin' is, I gotta enjoy eatin' tasty food. I can do that.
I heard there's a <Color:7>new café<Color:Default> around here. I'll think of a dish fit for that kind of a place.
Sorry, got nothin' for you.
(Don't have anywhere to recommend. I'll come back later after I've tried somewhere new.)
(Which joint should I recommend?)
(Never mind, maybe later.)
(I bet he'd like Matsuo Lamb Barbeque.)
(I bet he'd like Miyoshino.)
(I bet he'd like Curry Shop S.)
I thought it'd be a cinch to find a great place here in Sotenbori, but...
There're just too many to choose from! I'd like to try some more, but I'm already stuffed.
(I've seen that guy on TV. I wonder what he's doing here?)
Oh, I give up. There's no way I'm going to be able to try even half the places here.
Plus, I'm stuffed and hung over... Oh, my aching head.
(Hey, isn't that guy on TV? What's he doing around here?)
Oh, I'm so full. I think I'm going to throw in the towel.
Excuse me... Are you all right?
Hm? Oh, no, don't worry about me, I'm fine!
Oh, good. But I was wondering. Haven't I seen you on TV before?
You probably have. I'm Tatsuya. I'm something of a celebrity chef.
I'm Haruka Sawamura. So you're that guy who shows people quick and easy recipes, right?
I'm glad you've heard of me. Makes all my hard work worth it.
They say kids today don't watch much TV, so I'm always glad to meet one who does.
Actually, I've been on TV too, so I like to watch other shows to see what they're like.
Oh, are you a celebrity or something?
You could say that. I'm a pop idol, but I'm not very famous.
I'm afraid I don't know much about music. I'm more chef than celebrity, you see.
I almost didn't recognize you without the chef's uniform. So you're not on the job now?
Actually, I sort of am. I'm on this show where we try to help eateries across Japan by coming up with my own version of local dishes.
I've been going around trying the local fare in order to come up with a new idea.
Oh, so that's why you're so full. You really looked like you were in pain.
Yeah, it's tough trying to cover so much ground by my lonesome. It would really help if I had someone who could recommend great places.
Hey, what about you, Haruka-chan? Do you know any good places to eat around here?
Good places?
Yes, I was hoping you'd let me know if you ate anywhere that served really tasty local fare.
I'm hoping that if I try it myself, I'll get some ideas for a new dish.
Is anywhere that serves local dishes fine?
Anywhere's fine, but since you're underage, let's avoid places that serve alcohol.
I'll ask someone else about places like that.
I've already asked someone else about places like that.
Okay, if all you need is some recommendations, I'd be glad to help.
Great, thanks! And don't worry. I'll make it worth your while!
I'll give you some advice on making everyday meals yummier and fun. You won't regret this!
Ooh, sounds great. I can hardly wait.
Well, you know where to find me! Bye!
Ohhh... I need that turmeric drink.
Are you okay? You're hurting pretty bad by the looks of it.
I've been going to bars and izakaya, night after night. It's part of my job, but I can't take it anymore.
Hey, aren't you that guy who's on TV all the time? You're a chef or something, right?
It's always nice when someone's heard of me. I'm Tatsuya, celebrity⑬ Oooh...
Whoa, you sure you're all right? Try drinking some water or something.
I think I'm okay now. Thanks.
I don't know what sort of work you're doing, but drinking like that is hard on the body.
I know, but I want to help eateries across Japan by coming up with new twists on local cuisine.
So, I've been going around trying places that might give me some good ideas. You know, places with good local fare that's great with drinks.
Right... You mean like pubs, taverns, and places like that?
So that explains your current state. I guess it really is all part of the job, huh?
I can't say no to a place that's supposed to be good.
And I always finish what I order if it was recommended to me. As a chef myself, I feel that's important.
You're even more serious about food than you are on TV. I thought it was all an act.
Actually, the name recognition I get on TV helps draw more customers to my restaurant.
Seeing me on TV might make people curious about me, but my greatest challenge is satisfying them when they come to eat my food.
So your show is all part of that? You really have your hands full.
You can say that again. But hey, you could help me out by letting me know if you find a great place that serves local cuisine.
I don't think I could survive an attempt to visit every last restaurant myself.
Well, it's not like I'm an expert or anything, but I'll help where I can.
Great, thanks! You're a real lifesaver!
I don't think I can drink much more, so it would be great to pare down the places that serve alcohol to a promising few.
I've asked someone else about places that don't serve alcohol, so if you could focus on those that do, that would be great.
Honestly, I don't think I can drink much more, so you'd be doing me a huge favor.
I see you're in a predicament. I'd be glad to help.
If you introduce me to some good ones, I'll pay you back by teaching you my own special way to get the most out of your meals!
And that's something you don't want to miss!
Top-secret techniques from a TV personality? Sounds interesting.
Great, because I'm counting on you! You know where to find me!
I think I see. Each dish is the sum of its parts. What an interesting way to look at it!
So there are stories and emotions behind a chef's creations? How interesting.
Okay, so each meal should be a fun experience. That kind of reminds me of my work, too. We aim to please both our customers or audience.
There's a <Color:7>café that's mainly focused on sweets<Color:Default>, so I should probably come up with something that would be a hit with the ladies.
Interesting. I never would've thought of that. But I'll keep it in mind.
I guess I never thought much about the person making the food. But yeah, it makes sense.
You chefs sure think about a lot, don't you? This insider info is pretty interesting, though.
The place I'm trying to help serves <Color:7>yakiniku<Color:Default>, but it's not in Sotenbori. I'll have to think up a <Color:7>new dish<Color:Default> that would suit a place like that.
So this is the place you were talking about. Let's give it a try! Okay, I'll take one please!
Oh, I like this. It's really tasty!
Sorry, I just stopped by to say hi.
(I don't have any recommendations right now. Maybe I'll try a new place before I come back.)
(Which place should I recommend?)
(Maybe I should recommend Tsuruhashi Fugetsu.)
Okay, let's go. It's over this way.
(Maybe I should recommend Kushikatsu Daruma.)
(Maybe I should recommend Magutako.)
Sorry, but nothing new to report. I'll stop by again some other time.
(Maybe I'll recommend Zuboraya.)
Okay, let's go. I'll lead the way.
(Maybe I'll recommend Komian.)
(Maybe I'll recommend Kani Douraku.)
This isn't working. Most of the eateries around here are just too risky.
I'll never find a great place unless I get someone local to help me.
(What's with that guy? He doesn't look so good.)
What am I going to do? I feel like I'm in a minefield. I don't want to take another step.
You're looking kinda green. Is something wrong?
Huh? I look green? Well, I don't know if...
I'm not sure what that's supposed to mean, but I guess you're okay, so carry on.
No, wait! You live around here, don't you!?
I do, but why do you ask?
I'm Tatsuya, the celebrity chef. I have my own show on TV. Ring any bells?
What, really!? You're someone famous!?
Well, I wouldn't say famous, but I guess I am on TV.
How cool is that? Then again, I don't watch much TV, so I actually have no idea how cool that is.
I'm also wondering what a famous chef would possibly want with me.
Right, about that. I'm doing a show where I go around helping different eateries around Japan by coming up with new twists on local dishes.
I've been trying places that might give me some ideas, but Kineicho food is so different from what I'm used to. I don't know where to start.
Different? Oh, you must mean stuff like super spicy shaved ice or red bean paste pasta.
Yes! Exactly! It's been quite a shock. Everywhere I go, one strange dish after another!
Oh, come on now. Not everywhere. Sure, there are places like that, but they're pretty rare.
I beg to differ! No matter who I ask on the street, they steer me toward that kind of place.
Really? What exactly did you ask them?
I said, "Do you know anywhere that specializes in food unique to this area?"
There's your problem. If someone asked me that, I'd recommend something a little odd, too.
Maybe I should rephrase that and ask for places with tasty local dishes that aren't so strange.
I'm kind of broke right now, so pricey places are out, but I do know some reasonable ones.
Really!? Do tell! I'll make it worth your while!
Seriously!? All I have to do is tell you about them? Count me in!
Great, thanks! We have a win-win situation on our hands, then!
So, what exactly are we talking about here in terms of compensation?
Good question! I'll make it worth your while by... Drumroll, please...
Aww, fine. Well, I'll give you Tatsuya's special advice! It'll make your meals that much more enjoyable!
Special advice? Uh... What?
How to make your life better without money! With the right attitude, you can change your daily meals into something so much better!
Right... Later, pal.
No, please! Wait! Don't be like that!
If you say you're going to make it worth my while, you're gonna have to do better than giving me advice, ya quack.
